{{Quote|Well, they don't build them like that anymore.''"<br />"''That's because not even the Hutt Aviation Authority would certify this Narsh dirt-crate airworthy.|[[Fi Skirata|RC-8015]] and RC-1309|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
The '''Hutt Aviation Authority''', or simply the '''HAA''', had the duty of regulating and certifying vehicles within the scope of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] to be airworthy. They had a reputation for low standards when certifying aircraft, which was made note of<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'', which include the mention of the Hutt Aviation Authority, in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Niner Skirata|RC-1309]] while at the [[Fleet Support Air Station]] on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], when he observed a [[Nar Shaddaa agri-utility crop sprayer]] that appeared to be in danger of falling apart.<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hutt Aviation Authority was mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|Hard Contact]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
